verdict.rationale: Bento's Workflows are explicitly described as background automations triggered by behavior/events/tags that branch, delay, and execute steps autonomously (bento-docs-9, bento-docs-46), and these can be set up via AI-native surfaces like the MCP server, CLI, or natural-language builder (bento-docs-5, bento-docs-10, bento-docs-29). This directly supports an AI-native user configuring autonomous background automations. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that AI-configured workflows run reliably unattended, and more detail on monitoring/error-handling for long-running autonomous workflows.
